title: Filtering 184 blueprint items down to the evidence behind one recommendation
source: Counts queried from the research tool's database. The filters are the ones the tool exposes: stage, substage, role and record type.

frames.label: No filter
frames.note: Every item on the service blueprint. At this size the map is complete and useless: you cannot argue with 184 things at once.

frames.label: Substage: completing the report
frames.note: Filter to the one substage where the reporter meets the form. Thirty items, spread across five roles and the platform itself.

frames.label: Role: the restaurant manager
frames.note: Filter again to the role that actually does this work. Nine items, which is a conversation rather than a workshop.

frames.label: Type: pain point
frames.note: Six records. This is the evidence behind Decision 1, and each one is a sentence somebody said, traceable back to the line in the transcript it came from.
